newsitem.title: CHINA: China air con firm has $542 mln turnover Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: China air con firm has $542 mln turnover Jan-Oct.

text.p: Chinese air conditioner giant Zhuhai Gree Electronics Co Ltd had a business turnover of 4.5 billion yuan ($542 million) in January to October, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.

Gree Electronics, based in Zhuhai in the southern province of Guangdong, had completed a 560 million yuan technical upgrade that boosted its output capacity of air conditioners to 2.5 million units a year, Xinhua said.
The upgrade had helped turn Zhuhai into the world's largest air conditioner production base, Xinhua said without elaborating.
In January to October Gree had exported more than 100,000 air conditioners to Europe, the United States and southeast Asia, the agency said.
Gree also manufactured electric appliances such as fans, clothes driers and humidifiers, it said.
